title: convolution1dLayer
summary: Create a 1-D convolution layer compatibility object.
behaviors: Common convolution name-value options are preserved as properties.

example.input:
layer = convolution1dLayer(filterSize, numFilters)
layer = convolution1dLayer(filterSize, numFilters, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work. Convolution execution kernels remain future training/inference work.
